parlays.headline: No verified parlays today

blockers.text: No bookmaker-quoted parlay price. Doyen's odds feeds return single-market prices only, so it cannot verify that any bookmaker offers a given combination, or at what price.
No validated joint-probability estimate. Multiplying leg probabilities assumes the legs are independent and each leg is well calibrated; Doyen has no settled multi-leg record to support that.

parlays.disclosure: Parlays are higher-variance and win less often than single picks. Any parlay shown here would be paper-traded research, never a guarantee.
